sourceEvidence.excerpt: two clocks whose rates no longer maintain the expected ratio. Such an anomaly would establish a problem between measurement and model, not immediately a rewritten universe. Research must specify dimensionless quantities and competing explanations: thermal drift, shared software, an unknown field or a precise implementation change.
